purpose: Compose trusted source/AWS/TLS/prepared-key verification and runtime selection through the authenticated worker channel
limitations: Operator-prepared fixed catalog only; no resource provisioning or arbitrary-app launch.
Returned eligibility and selection are not application health or observed gateway readiness.
Initial selections/gateway startup, creator UI and bounded AWS provisioning/cleanup still need integration.
SQL/TLS are real fixtures; AWS task and SSM evidence are controlled in these tests.
Already-admitted SQL changes may commit after timeout/disconnect; reconcile before retry.
Process-local admission and expiry do not cap global spend or replace durable teardown.
